title: Verifiable Sampling for Delegated Generative Quantum Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative machine learning has shown remarkable results across a wide range of interdisciplinary tasks, motivating significant efforts toward Quantum Generative Models as a path to beyond-classical performance, given their capability of generating classically intractable distributions. However, comparatively little attention has been paid to securely delegating such computations to a powerful remote quantum server. In this work, we propose a blind and verifiable protocol for sampling that can be used for the inference phase of such quantum models. Such a protocol inherits blindness from Universal Blind Quantum Computing and achieves verifiability by exploiting known approaches based on trapification schemes. Alongside, to delegate the training phase, we discuss an extension of the previously proposed verifiable end-to-end Delegated Variational Quantum Algorithms (Inajetovic et al., Phys. Rev. Research, 2026).   Beyond the usual Accept

translated_title: 委托式生成量子机器学习中的可验证采样
translated_abstract: 生成式机器学习在众多跨学科任务中展现出卓越成果，鉴于量子生成模型能够生成经典计算机难以处理的分布，大量研究正致力于将其作为实现超越经典性能的路径。然而，将此类计算安全地委托给强大的远程量子服务器这一问题却相对较少受到关注。在本工作中，我们提出了一种盲化且可验证的采样协议，可用于此类量子模型的推理阶段。该协议继承了通用盲量子计算的盲性，并通过利用基于陷阱方案的已知方法实现可验证性。同时，为了委托训练阶段，我们讨论了对先前提出的可验证端到端委托变分量子算法（Inajetovic等人，Physical Review Research, 2026）的扩展。除了通常的接受……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种盲化且可验证的采样协议，用于安全委托生成式量子机器学习模型的推理阶段，并扩展了可验证的委托变分量子算法以覆盖训练阶段的委托。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a blind and verifiable sampling protocol for securely delegating the inference phase of generative quantum machine learning models, and extends verifiable end-to-end Delegated Variational Quantum Algorithms to cover the training phase.
